facts.subject: Tray unavailable error code
facts.value: ERR_TRAY_UNAVAILABLE — emitted when no system tray is present; app must degrade gracefully without orphaning a resident process

facts.subject: Notification permission denied error code
facts.value: ERR_NOTIFICATION_DENIED — OS notification permission denied; no error loop, session state remains visible on manual restore

facts.subject: Host subprocess start failure error code
facts.value: ERR_HOST_START_FAILED — shell stays alive, enters failed state, troubleshooting guidance shown in-app (UF4)

facts.subject: Update feed unreachable error code
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_FEED_UNREACHABLE — update check fails silently; no error dialog, no retry storm, startup not blocked

facts.subject: Non-whitelisted release URL rejection
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_URL_REJECTED — openExternal rejected for URLs outside RELEASE_HOST allowlist; rejection logged; app continues normally

facts.subject: Single instance lock error code
facts.value: ERR_SINGLE_INSTANCE — second launch routed to running instance: window open → focus existing; tray-resident → restore from tray; no second host subprocess

facts.subject: Notification dedup window
facts.value: DEDUP_WINDOW_MS = 10000 — same session + same event type within 10s merges into one notification updated with latest content; click still focuses that session

facts.subject: Crash recovery backoff and terminal state
facts.value: BACKOFF_SCHEDULE_MS = [2000, 4000, 8000]; 3 attempts; exhaustion → failed state with failure code retry-exhausted (ERR_RECOVERY_RETRY_EXHAUSTED-shaped message, ≤120-char failure detail); no infinite retry, shell stays alive

facts.subject: Release URL allowlist
facts.value: RELEASE_HOST = 'github.com', RELEASE_PATH_PREFIX = '/bigfaner/dsh-forge/releases'; only matching URLs may open externally

facts.subject: Update banner state machine
facts.value: UpdateBannerPhase = hidden | queued | shown | dismissed; while UF4 recovery mask active a new banner transitions to queued and is shown when mask exits; already-shown banner stays shown under mask; dismissed is terminal until restart

facts.subject: Carrier protocol
facts.value: dsh-app:// custom protocol carries the upstream SPA; no listening port is opened

facts.subject: Shell IPC channel namespaces
facts.value: dshForge.update.* and dshForge.recovery.* IPC channels with sender validation (ERR_IPC_SENDER_REJECTED on invalid sender)

facts.subject: Profile directory isolation
facts.value: dsh-forge profile directory is independent of upstream desktop profile; shared $DSH_HOME product data read/written only in upstream existing format

facts.subject: i18n locale mechanism
facts.value: Shell-layer tray/notification/banner texts resolved via upstream locale mechanism (zh/en) through t() CopyKeys; zero hardcoded strings; switching upstream locale changes tray and notification texts
